'''Voolattar''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Duros/Legends|Duros]] [[Chief engineer/Legends|Chief Engineer]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] living during the [[Galactic War]]. In [[3639 BBY]] he was stationed in [[Section X]] on [[Belsavis/Legends|Belsavis]], where general [[Avrun]] sent him to assist an Imperial with recovering an [[HK-51 series assassin droid]] from the wreckage of the ''[[Fatality]]''.<ref name="SWTOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Voolattar appears in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' during the Imperial quest "Fatal Errors" in [[Section X]].
